text: Niamh Corrigan captained the yacht Seren Aduial to victory in the Pallister Cup on Sunday, steering the Whitehaven-based crew through shifting winds off Larksmouth Bay. Race officials said the 38-foot cutter crossed the finish line 42 seconds ahead of the field after a tight final leg against the Harrow Star and Mavis Dawn. The annual regatta drew 17 boats and hundreds of spectators to the harbourfront, where gusts of up to 18 knots tested crews throughout the afternoon. “It was a disciplined, confident performance from Corrigan and her team,” said harbour master Elise Bramwell, who presented the trophy after the race. Organisers said the cup will remain on display at the Seaford Sailing Club until next month.
